comparison.objective: Insert a keyed brush roll into a robot vacuum and close its retainer; the candidate sets and locks an angular-gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and lower a long roll so round and square ends enter different sockets, then press a flap latch, versus coupled screw/jam-nut torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both roll ends seated, retainer latched, release, and stillness; candidate requires a precise stop setting retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot hardware and retention, but keyed two-end insertion and flap latching do not test adjustment preservation under locknut reaction.
